reject_reason: Vox-style motion design produced by prompting instead of by hours in After Effects is a craft upgrade for people who already own After Effects. None of the three has animation anywhere in their lists: Rick wants the phone answered, Anna wants documents routed and minutes that hold decisions, and Emma's nearest lines are about product photos and about one post going into five formats, which is not an animated explainer. There is no repeated business process here and no owner, and explainer animation that fronts a brand is the client-facing creative this audience punishes (RULES.md §11.2.5). Biggest reach in the batch by a distance, so it stays a reference for structure.
